QuestInfo.name: [Sengoku Warriors] The Black Heart of Edelstein
QuestInfo.1: The Oda spies captured near Honnou-ji were carrying intelligence about the Oda forces seen coming in and out of the Verne Mine. Go investigate further with Yukimori.
QuestInfo.2: The Oda spies captured near Honnou-ji were carrying intelligence about the Oda forces seen coming in and out of the Verne Mine. While eavesdropping on a conversation between Nagahide and a Black Wing Boss, you and Yukimori were discovered. You managed to escape with the help of the Resistance.
